name: D→A:BLACK
source:
High-school student, [url=/c74351]Shinjou Touya[/url] is what's known as a "Shinigami" -- an envoy of Hell who guides wandering souls, or "Creeps," who linger in the human realm. Each night, he hunts Creeps along with his partner [url=/c74352]Yuriel Arlencloyn[/url], a white-winged Angel of Heaven. However, one night during their hunt, they happen to rescue a girl named Natsuki, who recognizes Touya as her classmate. Normal humans are not meant to know of such things as Shinigami and Creeps, with Touya's past shrouded in mystery to even himself, and Natsuki also interested romantically in Touya, things quickly become complicated.

D→A:BLACK is a so-called "active novel" -- a visual novel-style adventure game with realtime battle sequences, divided into six chapters. The story unfolds from Touya's point of view, mainly through voiced dialogue sequences with still images. The player must occasionally make choices that will affect how the story plays out and which of the 11 endings are reached; some decisions are timed, and in many cases, not answering at all is also a valid option.

At specific points in the game, the player will be attacked by Creeps. Controlling Touya, his partner Yuriel, and his familiar Rin, the player must defeat the attacker and defend their team in a realtime battle. Each of the characters has various actions they can perform; Touya and Yuriel can attack, defend, and use special moves, while Rin can defend or recover the other two characters. Each character has an affinity; Touya's attacks are Dark, and work best against Light enemies, while Yuriel's attacks are the opposite, and Rin can switch between alignments. If any character's HP reaches 0, the battle is lost, and the game is over.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/dablack]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
高中生[url=/c74351]新城冬夜[/url]是俗称“死神”的存在——来自地狱的使者，负责引导徘徊在人间的游魂“克里普”。每到夜晚，他都会与搭档[url=/c74352]尤莉艾尔·阿伦克洛因[/url]一同猎杀克里普；尤莉艾尔是来自天界、长着白色羽翼的天使。然而，某晚执行任务时，他们偶然救下一名叫夏希的少女，而她认出冬夜是自己的同班同学。普通人本不应知道死神和克里普的存在，冬夜的过去就连他自己也不清楚，加上夏希对冬夜怀有爱意，事情很快变得复杂起来。

《D→A:BLACK》是一部所谓的“主动小说”，即带有实时战斗环节的视觉小说式冒险游戏，共分六章。故事以冬夜的视角展开，主要通过带语音的对话与静态画面推进。玩家偶尔需要作出选择，这会影响故事发展及最终进入的十一个结局；部分选项有时间限制，许多时候不作回答本身也是有效选择。

游戏进行到特定节点时，玩家会遭到克里普袭击。玩家需要操控冬夜、搭档尤莉艾尔以及使魔凛，在实时战斗中击败敌人并保护队伍。每名角色都有不同的可用行动：冬夜和尤莉艾尔可以攻击、防御并施展特殊招式，凛则可以防御或为另外两人恢复状态。角色各自具有属性：冬夜的攻击属于暗属性，对光属性敌人最有效；尤莉艾尔正好相反；凛则能切换属性。任何角色的HP降至0，战斗便会失败，游戏也随之结束。
